Thank you for your email about registering for a parking space in the garage at Flat 10, 30 Copperfield Walk, Willowbank, ZZ2 3ZZ.

This sits outside the maintenance team, so I have passed your question to our property management team. They will check the arrangements for the building and get back to you.

We're glad to hear the bath drain is now clear, so we have closed that maintenance request (ref NBL-027-8010). If the problem comes back, please just let us know.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings
